sections.Profile:
"Super Star" and "Olympics" are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in January 1975. Both games share a sports theme, with "Super Star" accommodating up to four players and "Olympics" designed for two players. The playfields feature two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, two standup targets, and two spinning targets
